profile.headline: Advisory Software Developer at PowerPlan, Inc.
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer who never stopped being curious.  
Over the years I've worked across client/server systems, enterprise integration, web applications, cloud platforms, data engineering, and now artificial intelligence.

I never followed a carefully crafted technology roadmap. I've always been driven by curiosity. When I encounter a new technology, product, framework, or idea, I want to understand it and explore how it can solve real problems. That mindset has allowed me to continually adapt and stay engaged in an industry that never stands still.

While much of my career was spent as a hands-on engineer, my focus has increasingly shifted toward helping teams adopt new technologies and engineering practices. Today, I am particularly passionate about the intersection of AI and software engineering and its potential to transform software delivery.

One of the initiatives I'm most proud of has been building and growing a centralized AI engineering platform that began as a personal exploration of AI-assisted software development and evolved into a foundational part of our organization's spec-driven AI development lifecycle. The platform brings together agent definitions, AI workflows, evaluation frameworks, authoritative reference materials, and reusable engineering assets into a shared ecosystem used across multiple product teams. What started as an individual effort has grown into a collaborative hub that enables consistent AI-enabled development practices, accelerates software delivery, and helps teams adopt emerging engineering approaches at scale.

I enjoy mentoring engineers, sharing knowledge, challenging assumptions, and helping teams navigate technology change. Whether evaluating emerging technologies, improving engineering processes, or building software, I believe the best results come from combining strong technical fundamentals with curiosity, adaptability, and continuous learning.

I remain actively engaged in the broader technology community through conferences, technical forums, and hands-on experimentation. These experiences help me stay current with emerging trends and bring practical insights back to the teams I support.

Artificial Intelligence | Software Engineering | Technical Leadership | Enterprise Architecture | Databricks | Azure | Cloud Computing | Developer Productivity | Engineering Innovation

positions.title: Advisory Software Developer
positions.description:
SENIOR TECHNICAL ADVISOR | SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT LEAD
Strategic lead for enterprise SaaS modernization, developer enablement, and Agentic AI orchestration.
STRATEGIC IMPACT & MENTORSHIP
● AI GOVERNANCE & STRATEGY: Acted as the primary architect for the enterprise adoption of agentic frameworks. Developed "Agent-as-Code" standards to move the organization from experimental, unstructured AI use to disciplined, multi-agent orchestration within the SDLC.
● SAAS MIGRATION & DEVEX: Leading the technical transition of a deeply complex, highly configurable client-server accounting application to a modern .NET/C# and GraphQL SaaS platform. Focused on building the internal tooling and VS Code integrations necessary to help developers navigate this architectural shift efficiently.
● MENTORSHIP & CODING BEST PRACTICES: Guiding the engineering team through the modernization of legacy financial logic. Established standards for mapping complex Oracle and SQL Server schemas into a dynamic, metadata-driven UI framework, ensuring high-fidelity data integrity across the new service layer.
● TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP: Serving as a mentor and Scrum Master, helping developers balance the reduction of technical debt with the adoption of AI-accelerated delivery to maintain high velocity during the platform's evolution.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Full Stack Lead Developer | Senior Software Engineer
Technical Lead & Scrum Master for an enterprise SaaS suite in the utility tax and accounting sector.

Orchestrated the delivery of the company’s first AI-driven cloud application and serves as an AI Champion, architecting custom agentic frameworks to accelerate the SDLC and unlock business capital.

Key Achievements
Predictive ML Innovation: Engineered the company’s first AI application using Azure Databricks, deploying a machine learning model to automate the identification of asset "in-service" dates. This solved a critical industry bottleneck where small-dollar projects were historically ignored, capturing immediate depreciation value and moving stagnant assets onto the ledger.

AI Framework & Agentic Tooling: Appointed as a select Enterprise AI Champion, leading the organizational rollout of the BMAD Method. Architected a custom BMAD extension module for our stack, integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) and custom agent personas to enable high-fidelity grounding. Developed VS Code integrations to establish "agent-as-code" standards, transitioning workflows from unstructured chat to disciplined multi-agent orchestration.

End-to-End SaaS Architecture: Lead development of a sophisticated SaaS platform utilizing Database-First Entity Framework (EF) to map complex Oracle and SQL Server schemas into a .NET/C# service layer. Exposed these entities via GraphQL endpoints to power a proprietary metadata-driven UI framework, using JSON and Angular to dynamically render accounting workflows based on backend data structures.

Strategic Leadership & Mentorship: As Scrum Master, mentored engineers on balancing technical debt with AI-accelerated delivery while influencing high-level system design decisions to modernize legacy financial logic for cloud-scale.

positions.title: Senior Advisory Software Architect
positions.description:
Full stack technical lead/senior engineer developing a cloud based, business critical enterprise EAM
application. The solution is based on a set of meta-data driven information models exposed through
a set of REST-based domain API micro-services communicating via a Kafka along with a Postgres/
Elastic Search back-end and a configurable, meta-data driven React.js front-end. In my role as a
technical lead/senior engineer I was responsible for delivering new UX components in support of
the field service inspection forms domain. I also provided mentoring and technical guidance to other
members of the team. I acted as scrum master and was involved at all levels of requirements gathering,
story construction, defining acceptance criteria and estimation. I provided input and feedback based on
my experience to help influence higher level system architecture and design decisions.
positions.insights: Skills: Jest · Software Design · IIS · HTML/XML · PostgreSQL · Agile Methodologies · Telerik · Web Development · Microsoft SQL Server · C# · JavaScript · COM · REST · Object Oriented Design · Enterprise Software · Microsoft Azure · Azure DevOps · Elastic Stack (ELK) · Web Services · SQL · React.js · SOA · Software Development · Apache Camel · Scrum · Java Enterprise Edition · .NET · ASP.NET AJAX · Oracle

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Over 20 years experience working on various enterprise applications for the utility industry.

(10 years)
Full stack senior engineer responsible developing and maintaining a complex, business critical plant shift operations targeted for Tier 1 power generation clients. The application was a C#/ASP.NET web forms application with an Oracle or SQL Server back-end. My role included both enhancing the application and troubleshooting and providing solutions for customer reported issues. I was also the primary developer of the external integration interface. A combination of web services and an adapter written in Java and Apache Camel EIP. I addition to my development role I also acted as scrum master for the team.

(1 year)
Senior engineer working on a best of breed Lockout/Tagout application. Responsibilities ran the gamut from requirements analysis to UX design, coding and testing. The application development started with UML defined in Rational Software Architect which generated/scaffold-ed Java application code and UX metadata based on proprietary code generation templates. The generated code was then extended to implement the business requirements. Automated unit tests were written with JUnit.
(3 years)
Senior engineer responsible for developing a mobile work force management application. The application was implemented in C++/MFC with a SQL Server back-end. The business layer was composed of DCOM objects and Windows services handling tasks such as optimizing resource availability and routing/mapping for the field technicians.
(6 years)
Senior engineer responsible for maintaining and extending a large N-Tier Enterprise Asset Management application implemented using PowerBuilder and Oracle PL/SQL. I was primarily responsible for third party application integration including CPM/scheduling and Electronic Document Management (EDM) systems. These were VisualBasic, VisualFoxpro or C++ COM applications with some additional back-end database procedures.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · C# · JavaScript · SQL · ASP.NET AJAX

positions.description:

Software developer for CMSI on various fixed bid in-house development projects. Responsibilities included coding, requirements gathering, working directly with clients.
